profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.demo: Demo accounts are shared by every visitor, so their profile cannot be changed.

password.title: Password
password.hint: At least 10 characters. Other browsers signed in to this account will be signed out.
password.weak: Use at least 10 characters, different from the current password.

wallets.title: Wallets
wallets.lead: Coupons and redemptions are paid to the wallet you register with the registrar. Link it here by signing a one-time message: no transaction, no fee.
wallets.connectHint: Connect Phantom, Solflare or Backpack to link it to your account.
wallets.signHint: Sign a message to prove you control
wallets.noSignMessage: This wallet cannot sign messages. Use Phantom, Solflare or Backpack.
wallets.demo: Demo accounts are shared by every visitor, so they cannot link wallets.

signup.title: Create an investor account
signup.lead: Self-registered investors link their own wallet and get verified to join bond issues.
signup.formLead: Email and password now; the wallet and verification come right after.
signup.name: Full name
signup.passwordHint: At least 10 characters; avoid common passwords.

errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.weak_password: Use at least 10 characters that are not a common password.
errors.invalid_params: Check the name and the email address.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.generic: Could not create the account. Try again in a moment.

steps.title: From sign-up to your first coupon

account.title: Create an account
account.text: Email and password; your account works on devnet and, later, mainnet.

wallet.title: Link your Solana wallet
wallet.text: Sign a message to prove it is yours: no transaction, no fee.

kyc.title: Get verified
kyc.text: Upload a document; the registrar attests your wallet on-chain (review is SIMULATED).

invest.title: Subscribe and receive coupons
invest.text: Buy at placement, vote in meetings, get coupons straight to your wallet.

steps.note: Devnet only: no real money moves.

none.title: Welcome! Two steps to your first bond
none.text: Link a wallet, then apply for KYC. Verification registers your wallet in the issues you choose.

submitted.title: Verification under review
submitted.text: The registrar is checking your documents. You will be notified when there is a decision.

rejected.title: Verification rejected
rejected.text: See the reason, fix it and apply again.
